# Security policy

## Reporting

Email `security@tierproxy.com` with details. Do not open a public issue.
PGP key available on request. We respond within 3 business days.

## Disclosure

We follow a 90-day coordinated disclosure window. If a fix is available
sooner, we publish the advisory at that point.

## Supported versions

| Version | Status |
|---------|--------|
| latest  | actively patched |
| 0.x     | best-effort until 1.0 lands |
